---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for SPECTRE
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement, triage
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement

A clear description of the problem you're trying to solve.

Example: "I'm always frustrated when..." or "It would be helpful if..."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like to see.

### User Experience

How would users interact with this feature?

```bash
# Example CLI usage
spectre scan --new-flag value target.com
```

### Expected Behavior

What should happen when this feature is used?

## Alternative Solutions

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Use Cases

1. **Use Case 1:** Description of when/why this would be useful
2. **Use Case 2:** Another scenario where this helps
3. **Use Case 3:** Additional context

## Scope

### In Scope
- What this feature should do

### Out of Scope
- What this feature should NOT do (helps set expectations)

## Impact

### Components Affected
- [ ] CLI (`spectre-cli`)
- [ ] Core library (`spectre-core`)
- [ ] TUI dashboard (`spectre-tui`)
- [ ] GUI application (`spectre-gui`)
- [ ] MCP server (`spectre-mcp`)
- [ ] Documentation

### Integration Points
- [ ] ProRT-IP (scanning)
- [ ] CyberChef-MCP (analysis)
- [ ] WRAITH-Protocol (communications)

## Additional Context

- Screenshots, mockups, or diagrams
- Links to similar features in other tools
- Relevant documentation or research

## Willingness to Contribute

- [ ] I'm willing to submit a PR for this feature
- [ ] I can help test this feature
- [ ] I can help document this feature
